## What I changed

The codebase already had a read-only computed field, `displayName`, wired through the same generated-DTO + MapStruct path. I mirrored that exact pattern for `initials` rather than inventing a new mechanism:

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `initials` property to the `Owner` schema (alongside `displayName`), so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field.

           : Character.toUpperCase(owner.getFirstName().charAt(0)) + "."
           + Character.toUpperCase(owner.getLastName().charAt(0)) + ".";
   }
   ```

This keeps the derivation logic as a single-responsibility unit next to its sibling `displayName`, so `RespondWithOwner` and every other endpoint that maps an `Owner` gets `initials` for free — no duplication in the function pipeline classes.
